plan.notes: Source: Agnes Scott College 2025-2026 Undergraduate Academic Catalog (official PDF), Business Management major requirements: ECO-104, 105, 215; BUS-202, 401; five electives from the catalog list, at least three at the 300 level. This plan uses BUS-211, BUS-375, BUS-302, BUS-345, ECO-309 (three at 300 level: 375, 302, 345). Note: the catalog's Business Management requirement list also names BUS-210 and BUS-340, but neither has a course description in the 2025-26 catalog course section, so they are NOT used in this plan. Course titles and prerequisites hand-transcribed 2026-09-30; semester sequence from catalog prerequisites (BUS-401 requires BUS-202 + BUS-211 and junior/senior standing). Advisor should confirm. Gen ed = SUMMIT 34 cr + 12 cr language + electives to 128.
